novel.skate-floaty-airtime: Skateboarder: first flat-ground flip trick stays airborne ~1.6-1.8 s (pop ~1.25-1.5 s, touchdown ~3.0-3.25 s) with rider and board hovering at near-constant height ~1.75-2.75 s; second trick ~1.3 s. Reported by all six layers (core-s1/s2/s3, router-s1/s2/s3; 11 findings). Frames confirm the long hang (frames 7-13 all airborne, rider tucked high against the sky); caveat: could be read as a slow-motion beat, though the approach plays at normal speed.
novel.skate-deck-underside-color: Skateboarder: during the first trick the truck side of the deck is black at 1.75-2.0 s, plain light wood at 2.5 s, dark again at 2.75 s, and grey/white in the second trick (~8.25 s). Reported by core-s1, core-s2, core-s3 (5 findings). Frames show the black-with-trucks / wood-with-trucks / dark sequence; a kickflip rotation could partly explain it. Adjacent to SKAT-1 (same moment, board underside rendered wrong) but a different symptom (colour, not wheel count/placement), so KT may want to fold it into SKAT-1 or reject it.
novel.skate-green-face-blob: Skateboarder: a saturated green glowing blob sits over the skater's eye/cheek at 0.5-1.0 s and moves with the face, absent before and after. Reported by core-s1 (2 roles) and core-s2. Frames 3-5 clearly show it on the face; the sun is near the head, so a green lens-flare ghost is a possible innocent reading.
novel.skate-shirt-logo-text: Skateboarder: chest logo on the black T-shirt is pseudo-lettering whose shape changes across frames. Single report (core-s1 baseline only). Frames show an unreadable red/green/white logo. Confirmed 'garbled text' class elsewhere, but uncorroborated here.

notes: FP rationale: car paint cream->mint is exposure only (frames show the same cream; same class as the emblem micro-morph FPs). Umbrella canopy colour (kimi FP precedent), ponytail colour drift (hair micro-morph class), market morphing into a covered hall (pro/argon stall-morph FPs). Skate board smear/feet through deck/twisted landing are motion-blur class with argon FP precedent, and 'beanie' hair is a hair micro-morph. Skate bowl appearing at 8.0-8.25 s: denser frames (12 fps) show the coping revealed gradually as the low camera retreats/tilts into the bowl, so it reads as camera move plus fisheye, which is a rejected class, hence FP. core-s2 woman-apple red-shirt 'treadmill' walker mapped to EXTRA:apple-frozen-background, since argon listed the red-polo woman among the frozen right-side pedestrians (lenient).
